author: nickyeow

english.text: I broke your ashtray.

jyutping: ngo5 daa2 laan6 zo2 nei5 go3 jin1 fui1 gong1。
text: 我打爛咗你個煙灰缸。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Please make yourself comfortable.

jyutping: ceoi4 bin2 co5 laa1，dong1 zi6 gei2 uk1 kei2 dak1 laa3。
text: 隨便坐啦，當自己屋企得喇。

author: nickyeow

english.text: You may come whenever you like.

jyutping: nei5 zung1 ji3 gei2 si4 lai4 zau6 gei2 si4 lai4 laa1。
text: 你鍾意幾時嚟就幾時嚟啦。

author: nickyeow

english.text: The clock gains five minutes a day.

jyutping: go3 zung1 mui5 jat6 dou1 wui5 faai3 ng5 fan1 zung1。
text: 個鐘每日都會快五分鐘。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Look at me when I talk to you!

jyutping: ngo5 tung4 nei5 gong2 je5 go2 zan6 mong6 zyu6 ngo5！
text: 我同你講嘢嗰陣望住我！

author: nickyeow

english.text: A drop of mustard fell and stained my tie during lunch.

jyutping: ngo5 sik6 aan3 go2 zan6 m4 siu2 sam1 dik6 zo2 dik6 gaai3 laat6 zoeng3 lok6 tiu4 taai1 dou6。
text: 我食晏嗰陣唔小心滴咗滴芥辣醬落條呔度。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I dozed off in the train and slept right past my station.

jyutping: ngo5 hai2 fo2 ce1 dou6 hap6 zoek3 zo2，zeoi3 mei1 gaau2 dou3 gwo3 zo2 zaam6。
text: 我喺火車度瞌着咗，最尾搞到過咗站。

author: cc_neko

english.text: It's no small matter.

jyutping: ne1 joeng6 m4 hai6 siu2 si6。
text: 呢樣唔係小事。

author: kaenif

english.text: I am very busy.

jyutping: ngo5 hou2 mong4。
text: 我好忙。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I can't find my glasses. I may have left them behind in the train.

jyutping: ngo5 wan2 m4 dou3 fu3 ngaan5 geng3，ho2 nang4 lau6 zo2 hai2 fo2 ce1 dou3。
text: 我搵唔到副眼鏡，可能漏咗喺火車到。

author: kaenif

english.text: It matters.
This is important.

jyutping: zung6 jiu3。
text: 重要。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Are you guys talking about me?

jyutping: nei5 dei6 hai6 mai6 gong2 gan2 ngo5 aa3？
text: 你哋係咪講緊我呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: I'm made from recycled plastic. Please reuse or recycle me!

jyutping: ngo5 hai6 jung6 ceon4 waan4 zoi3 zou6 ge3 sou3 gaau1 zing2 ceot1 lai4 gaa3。lo2 ngo5 heoi3 zung6 jung6 waak6 ze2 wui4 sau1 laa1！
text: 我係用循環再造嘅塑膠整出嚟㗎。攞我去重用或者回收啦！

author: nickyeow

english.text: The old man possesses great wealth.

jyutping: go3 aa3 baak3 zo6 jung2 geoi6 ngaak6 san1 gaa1。
text: 個阿伯坐擁巨額身家。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Why did Tom get into that car?

jyutping: dim2 gaai2 aa3 Tom zau2 zo2 jap6 go2 gaa3 ce1 dou3 ge3？
text: 點解阿Tom走咗入嗰架車到嘅？

author: nickyeow

english.text: You never arrive on time.

jyutping: nei5 ci3 ci3 dou1 ci4 dou3 ge3。
text: 你次次都遲到嘅。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I've always imagined Heaven as being a sort of library.

jyutping: ngo5 jat1 lou6 dou1 zoeng1 tin1 tong4 soeng2 zoeng6 sing4 jat1 zung2 leoi6 ci5 tou4 syu1 gun2 gam3 ge3 dei6 fong1。
text: 我一路都將天堂想像成一種類似圖書館咁嘅地方。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Sami wanted more money.

jyutping: sam1 mei5 soeng2 jiu3 do1 di1 cin4。
text: 森美想要多啲錢。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Are you still mad at me?

jyutping: nei5 zung6 nau1 gan2 ngo5 aa3？
text: 你仲嬲緊我呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: Intelligent people are often arrogant.

jyutping: di1 lek1 ge3 jan4 tung1 soeng4 dou1 hou2 zi6 ji5 wai4 si6。
text: 啲叻嘅人通常都好自以為是。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Intelligent people are often arrogant.

jyutping: di1 lek1 ge3 jan4 tung1 soeng4 dou1 hou2 hiu1 zoeng1。
text: 啲叻嘅人通常都好囂張。

author: nickyeow

english.text: "What does that word mean?" "Oh, it doesn't mean anything. It's just a made-up word that's supposed to sound like French."

jyutping: 「go2 go3 zi6 dim2 gaai2 aa3？」「o2，mou5 ji3 si1 gaa3，lou5 zok3 ceot1 lai4 baan6 faat3 man4 gaa3 zaa3。」
text: 「嗰個字點解呀？」「哦，冇意思㗎，老作出嚟扮法文㗎咋。」

author: thesilhouette

english.text: They went back into their room.

jyutping: keoi5 dang2 faan1 faan1 heoi3 zi6 gei2 gaan1 fong4。
text: 渠等返返去自己間房。

author: thesilhouette

english.text: You're not at all what I expected.

jyutping: nei5 jyun4 cyun4 bat1 fu4 ngo5 so2 mong6。
text: 你完全不符我所望。

english.text: All nature joined in rejoicing at the springtide, and Daphnis and Chloe, young and susceptible as they were, imitated whatever they saw or heard. Hearing the carols of the birds, they sang; at sight of the playful skipping of the lambs they danced; and in imitation of the bees they gathered flowers, some of which they placed in their bosoms, whilst with others they wove chaplets which they carried as offerings to the Nymphs.

jyutping: so2 jau5 daai6 zi6 jin4 dou1 hai2 ceon1 ciu4 jap6 min6 fun1 fu1 gan2，ji4 daat6 fu1 nei4 si1 tung4 hak1 lok3 ji1，seoi1 jin4 keoi5 dei6 nin4 heng1 tung4 ji6 sau6 soeng1 hoi6，daan6 hai6 keoi5 dei6 wui5 mou4 fong2 jam6 ho4 keoi5 dei6 gin3 dou3 waak6 ze2 teng1 dou3 ge3 je5。teng1 dou3 zoek3 zai2 ge3 zung6 go1，keoi5 dei6 zau6 coeng3 go1； gin3 dou3 joeng4 gou1 wun6 mei6 dei6 tiu3 joek6，keoi5 dei6 zau6 tiu3 mou5 ; wai6 zo2 mou4 fong2 mat6 fung1，keoi5 dei6 wui5 sau1 zaap6 faa1，zoeng1 di1 faa1 fong3 hai2 keoi5 dei6 ge3 hung1 hau2，ji4 tung4 kei4 taa1 jan4 jat1 cai4 zik1 ceot1 di1 faa1 waan4，jin4 hau6 zoeng1 keoi5 dei6 daai2 lai4 zou6 zai3 ban2 bei2 sin1 neoi2。
text: 所有大自然都喺春潮入面歡呼緊，而達夫尼斯同克洛伊，雖然佢哋年輕同易受傷害，但係佢哋會模仿任何佢哋見到或者聽到嘅嘢。聽到雀仔嘅頌歌，佢哋就唱歌； 見到羊羔玩味地跳躍，佢哋就跳舞 ; 為咗模仿蜜蜂，佢哋會收集花，將啲花放喺佢哋嘅胸口，而同其他人一齊織出啲花環，然後將佢哋帶嚟做祭品畀仙女。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: The greater part of the letter was charred to pieces, but one little slip, the end of a page, hung together, and the writing could still be read, though it was grey on a black ground. It seemed to us to be a postscript at the end of the letter, and it said: ‘Please, please, as you are a gentleman, burn this letter, and be at the gate by ten o’clock.’ Beneath it were signed the initials L. L.

jyutping: fung1 seon3 ge3 daai6 bou6 fan6 dou1 bei6 siu1 ziu1 zo2，daan6 hai6 jat1 zoeng1 zi2 zai2，jat1 jip6 ge3 mei5，gwaa3 maai4 jat1 cai4，seoi1 jin4 hai2 hak1 sik1 ge3 dei6 min2 soeng6 min6 hai6 fui1 sik1 ge3，daan6 hai6 ngo5 dei6 jing4 jin4 ho2 ji5 tai2 dou3 seon3 ge3 mei5 bou6，soeng6 min6 se2 zyu6：「m4 goi1，m4 goi1，jan1 wai6 nei5 hai6 jat1 go3 gwan1 zi2，siu1 zo2 ne1 fung1 seon3，jin4 hau6 hai2 sap6 dim2 cin4 dou3 zaap6 hau2。」soeng6 min6 se2 zyu6 L ge3 tau4 man4 zi6。
text: 封信嘅大部分都被燒焦咗，但係一張紙仔，一頁嘅尾，掛埋一齊，雖然喺黑色嘅地面上面係灰色嘅，但係我哋仍然可以睇到信嘅尾部，上面寫住：「唔該，唔該，因為你係一個君子，燒咗呢封信，然後喺十點前到閘口。」上面寫住 L 嘅頭文字。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: Chinese American actress Anna Mae Wong wanted to play the female lead in “The Good Earth,” but she did not get the role. “The reason why Anna Mae Wong wasn’t cast was because of this production law that was part of Hollywood. The industry itself put up a production law, and part of the clause was this anti-miscegenation clause that said that you could not have interracial romances on-screen,” said Yuen.

jyutping: waa4 jeoi6 mei5 gwok3 neoi5 jin2 jyun4 wong4 on1 naa4 mui4 soeng2 hai2《hou2 dei6 kau4》jap6 min6 sik1 jin2 neoi5 zyu2 gok3，daan6 hai6 keoi5 mou5 dak1 dou3 ni1 go3 gok3 sik1。「wong4 on1 naa4 mui4 zi1 so2 ji5 mou5 bei6 syun2 zung3，hai6 jan1 wai6 ni1 go3 hai6 ho4 lei5 wut6 ge3 zai3 zok3 faat3。ni1 go3 hong4 jip6 bun2 san1 zau6 zai3 ding6 zo2 jat1 go3 zai3 zok3 faat3，ji4 ni1 go3 tiu4 fun2 ge3 jat1 bou6 fan6 zau6 hai6 ni1 go3 faan2 wan6 hyut3 tiu4 fun2，waa6 nei5 m4 ho2 ji5 hai2 ngan4 mok6 soeng6 min6 jau5 kwaa1 zung2 zuk6 ge3 long6 maan6 gwaan1 hai6。」jyun4 wai5 zit3 waa6。
text: 華裔美國女演員黃安娜梅想喺《好地球》入面飾演女主角，但係佢冇得到呢個角色。「黃安娜梅之所以冇被選中，係因為呢個係荷里活嘅製作法。呢個行業本身就制定咗一個製作法，而呢個條款嘅一部分就係呢個反混血條款，話你唔可以喺銀幕上面有跨種族嘅浪漫關係。」袁偉哲話。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: "Hello? Mom?" "Yes, Sami." "Is Dad home?" "Yes." "Can I talk to him?" "He's taking a shower." "Mom?" "Yes, sweetheart." "I have something important to tell you. It's very important." "Yes?" "You need to be very strong, OK?" "Yes, what is it?" "Something terrible happened to Farid." "What?!" "Mom? Hello? Are you still there?" "Oh, my God!" "Mom... Mom... Farid is dead." "Oh, my God!" "Mom... I'm sorry, Mom, I'm really sorry."

jyutping: 「nei5 hou2？maa1 mi4？」「hai6 aa3，saat3 mai5。」「baa4 baa1 hai2 uk1 kei2 maa1？」「hai6。」「ngo5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 tung4 keoi5 king1 haa5 gai3？」 「keoi5 cung1 gan2 loeng4。」「maa1 mi4？」 「hai6 aa3，tim4 sam1。」 「ngo5 jau5 di1 zung6 jiu3 ge3 je5 soeng2 tung4 nei5 gong2。hou2 zung6 jiu3。」「hai6 aa3？」「nei5 jiu3 hou2 ging6，hou2 maa1？」「hai6 aa3，hai6 me1 lai4 gaa3？」「faat3 lei5 dak1 faat3 sang1 zo2 di1 ho2 paa3 ge3 si6。」 「me1？！」「maa1 mi4？nei5 hou2？nei5 zung6 hai2 dou6？」 「o2，ngo5 ge3 soeng6 dai3！」 「maa1 mi4 ... maa1 mi4 ... faat3 lei5 dak1 sei2 zo2。」「o2，ngo5 ge3 soeng6 dai3！」「maa1 mi4 … … deoi3 m4 zyu6，maa1 mi4，ngo5 zan1 hai6 hou2 deoi3 m4 zyu6。」
text: 「你好？媽咪？」「係呀，薩米。」「爸爸喺屋企嗎？」「係。」「我可唔可以同佢傾下計？」 「佢沖緊涼。」「媽咪？」 「係呀，甜心。」 「我有啲重要嘅嘢想同你講。好重要。」「係呀？」「你要好勁，好嗎？」「係呀，係咩嚟㗎？」「法里德發生咗啲可怕嘅事。」 「咩？！」「媽咪？你好？你仲喺度？」 「哦，我嘅上帝！」 「媽咪 ... 媽咪 ... 法里德死咗。」「哦，我嘅上帝！」「媽咪 … … 對唔住，媽咪，我真係好對唔住。」
